drafts.label: Reply · outsource craft reputation (values jab)
drafts.body:
If writing and thinking are your craft, announcing you'll outsource both is a strange long-term plan.

Readers can feel when a mind left the room.

Tools can help. Turning "I don't practice the thing I'm known for" into a brand is a different choice — and yeah, it shows up later in the work.
drafts.why: Grounded in livelihoods-on-writing/thinking + outsourcing = not worth reading; values jab, no invented stats.
drafts.tip: Stay on craft + reputation + outsourcing thinking/writing only.

quality.notes: Opens on craft contradiction; mind-left-the-room human; tools vs brand distinction grounded in source thrust.

drafts.label: Reply · open infra beyond weights (blunt systems)
drafts.body:
Open weights are the headline. The boring open infra is what actually makes them usable.

Sandboxes, shared agent memory, KV offload — that's what turns "I can download a model" into "a student or solo builder can actually run a loop."

Table stakes moved. Next fight is who ships the unglamorous layer for free.
drafts.why: Grounded in open-weights-as-table-stakes + open sandboxes/memory/upstream KV/RoCE; access×efficiency angle.
drafts.tip: Don't invent benchmark numbers; only infra categories named in post.

quality.notes: Headline vs boring infra hook; student/solo builder access without inventing product claims; table stakes from source.

drafts.label: Short · close the tab, three ugly bullets
drafts.body:
Hope without a practice is just mood.

One rule I've been trying: after any AI answer, close the tab and write three bullets from memory before I accept it.

Ugly bullets. Half wrong. Mine.

That's still where the learning lives — not in the polished paragraph the model already finished for me.
drafts.why: Independent AI-education pillar — memory-first practice after AI; zero mashup of craft-reputation outsourcing or open-infra table stakes.

quality.notes: Independent insight: three closed-tab memory bullets beat accepting polished AI text for real learning. Bookmark-worthy practice; soul on ugly/half-wrong; not pack collage.
